projects.title: 【开源自荐】MastraWork：把 Agent 运行组织成任务的开源桌面 AI 工作台
projects.author: movclantian

github.name: movclantian/mastra-desktop
github.description: Local-first multi-agent coding workbench built on Electron, React and the Mastra framework. 本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，基于 Mastra + Electron，把一次 Agent 运行组织成可暂停、可回溯、可交接的任务。

projects.summary: 项目：MastraWork | 平台：Windows / macOS / Linux | 许可：Apache-2.0 | 最新版本：v0.0.7 它是什么 一个本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，底层是 Mastra 框架 + Electron。 它想解决的事情很具体：现在多数 AI 工具给你一段回答，事情就停在那儿；代码改到一半让它继续，它常常重新把文件读一遍，从接不上的地方往下编。前面聊过的上下文，像是没发生过。 MastraWork 的做法是把一次 Agent 运行组织成一个任务。任务落在具体的工作区里，长在线程上，每一步都留下痕迹。它能暂停，能回头检查，也能交给团队里的其他成员接着看。断掉之后不是从头再来，而是接着往下走。 它面向软件工程和知识工作：Agent、团队、工作区、终端、浏览器、MCP、技能和资料库收在同一个应用里，围着同一个任务转。 功能详解 🧭 工程任务 读取代码、全局搜索、编辑与 AST 修改、运行命令、查看差异、调用 LSP 都在里面。关键是读、写、执行分开授权，每一步都有记录，不是开一个大权限就全放开。 🛡️ 受控执行 计划、构建、复查三种模式，切的是「Agent 现在能碰什么」。人工询问和批准留在流程里，高风险动作停下来等人确认，不靠模型自觉。 👥 Agent 团队 主 Agent 可以带一群专家成员，支持委派、交接、并行、分支、循环和审批工作流。复杂任务拆给合适的人，而不是一个 Agent 硬扛。 🧩 开放扩展 模型 Provider、MCP Server、技能与插件、浏览器、资料库、记忆和网页检索，按需接入，不绑定任何一家模型服务。今天用这家，明天想换，配置改一下就行。 🖥️ 桌面集成 Electron 主进程、原生浏览器视图、PTY 终端、系统通知、凭据保险库。API Key、OAuth token 和 Cookie 由桌面主进程的凭据保险库保管。 📚 记忆与资料库 记忆跨会话保留；资料库统一收文档、表格和网页；用量、费用和历史数据随时可查。 一个任务是怎么走完的 一个任务从开工到验收，Agent 手里的权限是变的，分三个阶段： 1. 计划 —— 先把事情想清楚，读代码、查资料、出方案。 2. 构建 —— 方案定了再动手，改代码、跑命令、推进任务，每一步都留下记录，随时可以停下来回头看。 3. 复查 —— 对照差异和工作记录验收，高风险的操作在这一步需要人批准。 读、编辑、执行和外部工具在三阶段各有一套策略，图的入口在应用内设置里，实际安全性以服务端权限检查和测试记录为准。 技术栈 | 部分 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 桌面外壳 | Electron 44、electron-vite、electron-builder | | 界面 | React 19、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 4、CodeMirror 6、xterm | | Agent 框架 | Mastra 1.77（core、memory、rag、mcp、observability） | | 数据与检索 | libsql、DuckDB、fastembed 本地向量 | | 代码与文档 | Shiki 高亮、Mermaid、KaTeX、PDF 与 Office 解析 | | 工具链 | Biome、Knip、pnpm workspace | 快速开始 三个平台都有现成安装包，也可以从源码跑（需要 Node.js >=22.19.0 <23、pnpm 12.11.2）： sh corepack enable corepack prepare pnpm@12.11.2 --activate pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm dev 首次启动后配一个可用的模型 Provider、选一个工作区目录即可。需要网页检索、浏览器、MCP 或技能时，再按实际服务分别配置凭据。默认本地数据目录是 ~/.mastrawork，Mastra 服务跑在本机 4111 端口。 下载： 关于「本地优先」 需要说清楚一点：「本地优先」说的是桌面宿主、默认工作区和本地数据边界优先留在本机，不表示所有推理都在本地完成。模型推理走哪个服务由使用者自己配置，模型服务会收到你发过去的提示词和选定的上下文。 项目还在很早期（v0.0.7），用着顺手或者踩到坑，都欢迎来 Issues 说一声。

projects.title: Show HN: Parsimony – an open-source benchmark for how much code AI models add
projects.author: lasu
projects.summary: Existing benchmarks measure solve rate and token output/cost, but don't punish excess code, which makes a codebase harder to work with in the long term. I wanted to measure this since it matters most for long-term projects. Method: it takes the patches that benchmarks already publish (DeepSWE, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Live) and counts "coding units": syntax elements like statements, calls, names and literals. I didn't use lines of code, so cramming code isn't rewarded. Deleted code is subtracted, so it measures net units. GPT-6 and Claude 5.5 have no public patches yet, so I ran them myself on 3–10 tasks on my own subscriptions (shown as faded circles, not ranked). Any feedback or model contributions are welcome, especially public patch exports for newer models. GitHub: https://github.com/La5u/Parsimony Not affiliated with any of the benchmarks.

projects.title: [送码]从好用到爽用， Mu3ic 重磅更新，现已支持 Navidrome/Jellyfin/Emby
projects.author: aslehx
projects.summary: [上一帖]( https://www.v2ex.com/t/1246531)发出来一周，Mu3ic 从 1.0 更新到了 1.5.1 。楼里提的桌面歌词、媒体库重复、WMA 播不了、登录要手填 `http://` 这些都改了。变化最大的一件：除了 Navidrome / Subsonic ，现在也能连 **Jellyfin 和 Emby** 了。 - 主页： https://mu3ic.xyz - 直接下载 APK： https://dl.robb3n.site/mu3ic/Mu3ic-stable.apk - 已经装了的，在 App 里检查更新就行 ## 送码 送 20 个激活码：**评论区前 20 位留下邮箱的朋友**，我把码发到邮箱，送完为止。 邮箱收到的激活码一机一码，**不能换绑**，**24 小时后失效，过期不补**，请收到后尽快兑换，谢谢🙏 。激活入口：设置 → 关于 → Pro → 输入激活码。 没抢到的，也可以在 App 里用推广期特价 ~~38~~ **18 元**买断（推广价到 11 月 5 日）。买了 Pro 的可以进官方讨论群（ https://t.me/+RFkD6vL_889iMjQ9 ），进群后私聊我，拉你进 Pro 资深用户群。资深用户群后面会发布「下歌 → 打标签 → 曲库管理」的自动化入库最佳实践，定制需求也优先响应，Agent 环境搭建（独家）和开发最佳实践也会作为增值服务陆续发布，下图为独家 Mac 端代理工具和跨 Agent 任务编排系统 ![Pro 增值服务]( https://i.imgur.com/0F17Y3N.jpeg) ## 接下来做什么 Mu3ic 一开始的定位是「只做流播」。但上一帖和群里问得最多的是：我的歌就放在 NAS 的共享目录里，没架 Navidrome ，能不能直接听？ 所以方向调整了一下，分两步： 1. **先把服务器兼容做完**：Navidrome / Subsonic 、Jellyfin 、Emby 已经接上； Plex 看需要的人多不多 2. **再做文件来源**：手机本地的音乐，以及直连 NAS 上的文件（ WebDAV / SMB ），不用另外架媒体服务器。这次改架构时已经把位置留好了 你的歌放在哪、怎么连，欢迎在楼里说一声，我按需求排先后。 ## 一、能连的服务器更多了 ### 连 Jellyfin 和 Emby Jellyfin 10.9 及以上、Emby 4.8 及以上都能连。整个曲库同步到手机上，翻、搜、排序都读本地，下载、播放缓存、离线模式、歌词、歌单、收藏，用起来和连 Navidrome 时一样。 - 密码只用来换一个登录凭证，**不存在手机上**。服务器上改了密码、或者把这台设备退出了，首页会提示「要重新登录」，再输一次密码就行，界面和正在播的不会重来 - 服务器本身没有的功能直接不出：Jellyfin 、Emby 没有智能歌单，Emby 不存评分。设置 → 服务器的曲库卡上有一行「 Jellyfin / Emby 上有什么不一样」，所有差别都写在那里 - 这两种服务器不记每一次播放，所以听歌统计、听歌分析读的是这台手机自己记下的播放，卡片上会写「这台手机」 ### 登录不用再填 `http://` 和端口 @noming 提的。现在登录分两步：先填 IP 或域名，App 自己去试 Navidrome 的 4533 和 Jellyfin / Emby 的 8096 ，认出是哪种服务器；同一个地址上找到不止一种，就列出来让你选。第二步再输账号密码。 ### 外面连不上家里，自动换地址（ Pro ） 一个曲库可以存好几个地址，比如家里的局域网 IP 加外网域名。以前只在打开 App 登录时挑一个连得上的；现在用着用着当前地址断了，也会自动换到连得上的那个，**正在放的歌不停，队列还在**。 ![连接服务器]( https://i.imgur.com/Wt4vaVJ.jpeg) ## 二、声音：均衡器、歌曲切换、音质 ### 自带的均衡器（免费） 以前用的是手机系统的均衡器，段数和预设因机型而异，有的手机干脆没有。现在换成 Mu3ic 自己处理声音： - 10 段、±12 dB ，10 个预设加一格「自定义」，**每台手机上都一样** - 面板上画的是实际的频响曲线：曲线正好穿过每个滑杆，看到的就是听到的 - 自动防破音：曲线最高抬了几 dB ，就整体降几 dB ，面板上写的和实际降的是同一个数；关掉均衡器时声音原样通过，一个比特都不动 - 以前调过的，会换算进「自定义」 均衡器对所有人免费。 ### 每个耳机记住自己的那一套（ Pro ） 平时所有输出共用一套。哪个耳机想不一样，就在面板「当前输出」里给它单独一套：扬声器、有线耳机各一份，蓝牙和 USB 按设备名分。以后一接上就自动换，不弹提示。 ### 歌曲切换：交叉淡化 / 淡出淡入（ Pro ） 设置「播放」里选交叉淡化或淡出淡入，2–12 秒。 - **同一张专辑按顺序播时不淡**：现场专辑、无缝衔接的概念专辑不会被切碎 - 手动切歌可以单独开一个 0.5 秒的短淡化，点下一首不再是生硬的一刀 - 实现上是两个播放器轮流上场：这首快结束前，就把下一首在另一个播放器里准备好，到点交接 ### Wi-Fi 和流量分开设音质 @ershiwo 提的。设置「播放」里分成「 Wi-Fi 音质」「流量音质」两组（原画 / 320k / 192k ），流量那组没设过就跟 Wi-Fi 一样。出门从 Wi-Fi 切到流量，正在播的这首不打断，从下一首起换档。缓存里同一首如果已经有更高档的完整一份，低档的那份会自动删掉。 ![均衡器与歌曲切换]( https://i.imgur.com/W3G0YW1.jpeg) ## 三、听歌数据 ### 听歌分析（免费） 首页听歌统计卡下面点进去，用最近 60 天的播放记录和你的曲库算： - **什么时候听**：24 小时柱状图，可以分工作日 / 周末看 - **最近在听谁**：上期前 5 和本期前 5 的名次变化 - **新歌还是老歌**、**一次听多久** - **口味偏向**：哪个流派你听得比它在曲库里的占比多几倍 - **曲库用到了多少** - 最后是几件能一键去做的事：常听却没收藏的、入库了还没听过的新歌、冷落了很久的收藏、好久没听的老歌 全部在手机上算，不多发一个请求。 ![听歌分析]( https://i.imgur.com/untGRXZ.jpeg) ### Scrobble 门槛自己定 设置「播放 → Scrobble 上报」：播到 25 / 50 / 75 / 90%，或者满 30 秒 / 1 / 2 / 4 分钟，先到哪个算哪个（默认 50% 或 4 分钟）。按实际听的时间算，拖动跳过去的不算；单曲循环、按上一首回到开头，算新的一遍。 ## 四、曲库：几十万首也翻得动 ### 排序、筛选、跳转 曲目、专辑、歌手三页现在是同一套操作：次行「排序 · 筛选 · 跳转 · 计数」。 - 排序每项可以选正序 / 倒序，列表按排序分段，段头吸顶 - 按名字排时按首字母分段，**中文按拼音**，在手机上算，不用在服务器上填排序标签 - 筛选可以叠好几组，每个选项后面带计数 - 每页各自记住排序和筛选；点一首就在筛选结果里接着播，开着随机就在整个筛选结果里随机 ### 几十万首不再闪退 有位朋友的曲库 27 万首，同步到 9 万多首时 App 直接闪退。原因是整库一次性读进内存。现在整库的计算改成紧凑的内存表，只取用得到的那几首，几十万首也能正常打开、正常出混音。 ![曲库排序筛选]( https://i.imgur.com/lqCqpSp.jpeg) ## 五、细节 - **应用说明**：设置「关于 → 应用说明」，37 篇，写在 App 里，能搜，断网也能看。功能弹层里的「怎么回事？」直接打开对应那篇 - **更新下载更稳**：两条线路（国内、首尔），慢了自动换下一条，断了接着下、不从头来；弹层里看得到线路、速度和剩余时间。下完照旧校验 sha256 和签名再装 - **更新完告诉你更新了什么**：装好后发一条「已更新」通知，第一次打开时弹出这一版的更新内容，设置「关于」里随时能回看 - **恢复购买**：同一台手机重装后，在解锁页一键找回 Pro ；已激活的能查看、复制激活码，并说明怎样换到新手机 ![应用说明与更新内容]( https://i.imgur.com/WRlvmnK.jpeg) ## 两处调整 - **Pro 范围**：播放缓存、倍速与音调、定时关闭、深色与跟随系统改为 Pro ，均衡器改为对所有人开放。基础版固定浅色；已经缓存完整的曲目照常能播 - **隐私**：上一帖写过「检查更新不带任何标识」，1.5 起改了：检查更新、下载更新包、激活与购买这几类发给 Mu3ic 服务器的请求，会带一个随机生成的安装编号（存在这台手机上，重装就换），用来统计安装量和更新有没有装上。**发给你自己音乐服务器的请求不带**，曲库和播放记录照旧只在你的服务器和手机上 ## 最后 Mu3ic 是播放器，连的是你自己的服务器，不提供任何音乐。有问题、想要的功能，在楼里回我，或者来群里说。

projects.title: Show HN: Hatoba, an open-source SSH client with an AI assistant and E2EE sync
projects.author: scarletkc

github.name: scarletkc/Hatoba
github.description: Open-source desktop SSH client with an AI assistant and end-to-end encrypted sync through your own Cloudflare account

projects.summary: I've used SSH tools for years and didn't really plan on building yet another SSH client, but I ended up building one the way I wanted. Hatoba is a desktop SSH client for Windows, Linux and macOS. It's written in Rust with Tauri 2 and MIT licensed. Each terminal has an AI assistant panel next to it. You describe the problem, and it reads the terminal screen, runs commands, types into the shell, and reads, edits and searches files on the host to find the cause and fix it. You can approve every command and edit it before it runs, let a model you pick approve the safe ones, or turn approval off. Files it changes show a diff you can undo. It works with any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API, local models included, and supports skills and MCP servers. Sync doesn't go through a server of mine. Hatoba deploys a Worker and a D1 database to your own Cloudflare account and syncs hosts, keys and AI conversations through them. The free plan usually covers personal use. Everything is encrypted on the device before it leaves. Keys are derived from your master password with Argon2id, every item is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and the Worker only stores ciphertext plus the hashes it needs to sign you in. Someone who gets hold of the whole Cloudflare account still only gets ciphertext. Sync is optional, and everything works offline without it. The usual SSH client features are there too: groups, tags and fuzzy search, ~/.ssh/config import, ProxyJump and SOCKS5/HTTP proxies, an SFTP panel, local port forwarding, and a key vault that imports OpenSSH, PEM and PuTTY keys. There's also a dashboard showing CPU, memory, disk and network for every saved host, read over plain SSH with nothing installed on the servers. SSH is russh, the terminal is xterm.js with the WebGL renderer, and the UI is React. I develop on Windows, so it's Windows first, with a custom title bar that supports Snap Layouts and Mica, and working CJK input methods. The Linux packages and the macOS build get far less testing on real machines. The macOS build is Apple Silicon only and isn't notarized, so macOS blocks it on first launch until you allow it in Privacy & Security. Bug reports from Linux and Mac users would help the most. Website: https://hatoba.fog.moe Downloads: https://hatoba.fog.moe/download/

projects.title: Show HN: Treesum – Replace MS Excel/Project with a Code Editor
projects.author: mallahan
projects.summary: # Intro The goal of this software is to make it easy to get the plan that's in your head onto the page. Start with the outline then add details. Then more details. Then numbers: costs, time, quantities. Then organize and categorize with #tags. All the sums, graphs and pivot table functionality happens automatically in the Calcs, Timeline, Stats views. And everything looks nice without you having to format it. Currently, it's all local, saved in your browser. Save your plan permanently by downloading the '.tsum' file. Open (upload) the '.tsum' to start working again. Everything happens in the browser. The files are stored where ever you like. The '.tsum' file is just text - human and AI readable. Use it to plan anything. We hope it works like your brain does - by organizing things in trees. # Story This software is entirely vibe-coded. It had to be - none of my developer friends would help me out. The front end JS on this app is too complex for a part time developer like myself. I've had this idea for a while and was only able to bring it to life because of AI. It may not gain traction, but at least I can put it out there, use it myself, or stop thinking about it altogether. It's amazing to see it and actually use it - to know if my idea was good or not, at least for me. And I'm actually happy with it and have been using it. If you have thoughts about the idea, feel free to let me know. I'm open to suggestions for improvement. # Disclaimer This tool is mainly intended to help with project planning. But it can be used for any data that looks more like a tree than a table. Creating a quote or estimate for one-off projects is my favorite use case. The varying structure of costs across lumber, electrical, concrete and labor fits well. Obviously, it doesn't replace all the many things Excel can do. It tries to improve on MS Project by making it easier to get your schedule on the page by coding into an editor instead of poking at menus in a GUI. It is still a proof of concept at this point, not a bullet-proof software package. If there's interest, it will be developed further. For now, it's good enough for me. # Roadmap I want this software to be the Excalidraw of Excel: free, simple, browser-based and fun to use. There are great things that Excalidraw does that would require servers and more costs. These features could be turned into a paid product if there is interest. So, if you're interested, please let me know: treesum.app (at) gmail.com. # Thanks HN This project would not have been possible with out AI. But also not without HN. Reading HN nearly every work day really shapes how to think about software and presenting it to people - especially for someone who is not a full-time developer. It's a great community and I've happily been a member since (at least) 2013.

projects.title: Show HN: BScaff - A CLI tool for project scaffolding and snippets
projects.author: akashnagcs
projects.summary: I built BScaff, a CLI tool for saving and reusing project structures, templates, files, and text snippets. It can serve as a URL bookmark tool as well. It started with project scaffolding, but I wanted something more general-purpose: a tool that could save almost any reusable starting point and bring it back whenever needed. For each language, I had a specific way of structuring projects that I have refined over years, but I could not find any tool which can quickly help to generate such scaffolding quickly. Copier and Cookiecutter exists but they depend on templates, and I didn't want to create templates for such tasks. One more use-case I had was when I used AI chatbots who suggest some project structure, and I want to quickly create that. So I wanted something offline which can quickly help me save and recreate file trees. Then I added snippets to it too, but I mostly use it for notes taking personally. Some things you can do with it: * Save Git repository templates locally and use them offline whenever you need to create a new project * Create reusable templates from existing directories * Save and recreate directory structures by copying ASCII file trees and the tool will read it from clipboard and recreate it (or save it for later) * Save collections of files and generate them again in another directory * Save text snippets and either copy them to the clipboard or generate files from them The idea is to avoid repeatedly recreating the same boilerplate, directory structures, configuration files, etc. And you can use it as a note-taking app as well with snippets. It has templates support as well with Jinja-based variable replacement. Template updates are supported, but project updates are not yet implemented, have planned it for future. It is written in TypeScript, runs on Node.js, and is available on npm. GitHub: https://github.com/akashnag/bscaff Install: npm install -g @akashnag/bscaff Feedback, feature suggestions ( I already have a big backlog though :P ), and contributions are welcome!

projects.title: Show HN: Veduta – Personal Agent with GenUI
projects.author: Silvio194
projects.summary: The idea came to me while I was watching a livestream with Antirez and mr RIP, one of the first streams they did together. I thought Antirez might be right when he said that once AI agents moved beyond the terminal, we would reach a whole new level. So I decided to create "Veduta", which is basically Hermes/OpenClaw but with a UI. What exactly is the advantage? It could track everything for you and give you visual feedback without you actually having to ask the same questions again, because all the information is stored inside the daemon running on the server. Instead of having something that just runs, you have something that delivers "sheets with written reports that you can consult at any time." This translates into saving tokens and accessing information faster, while also keeping everything organized. I don't know if you'll appreciate this open-source project, but feel free to leave any kind of feedback. It's always welcome! :) Thanks, everyone!

projects.author: msuozzo
projects.summary: go-git2 is a Go git library (read-only for now) using libgit2 transpiled to Go with wasm2go. As a result, it builds with CGO_ENABLED=0 and cross-compiles without a C toolchain. It supports 64-bit Linux, macOS, and Windows today. While go-git has been great for my uses, its performance on larger repos and quirky differences from the git CLI output have been tricky to work with. I'm a huge fan of wasm2go and go-sqlite3 and wanted to apply the same approach and see what could be done. Incredibly happy with the results thus far, with 10-100x improvements on my real-world use cases. On the django repo, finding commits touching a file goes from 40s with go-git to 350ms, against 255ms for git itself. And the only unsafe is in wasm2go's bounds-checked memory accesses! The API follows go-git v5, so read-only code is mostly a drop-in (still a few constructs to port). Write support is down the road. The main module is MIT and the libgit2 module keeps the upstream license (GPLv2 w/ linking exception). Give it a go!

projects.title: Show HN: Ret – An inbox and canvas for your Codex and Claude Code agents
projects.author: itsjustmechris
projects.summary: Over the last few weeks I've really been using Codex and Claude to solve a lot of parallel tasks, across a lot of different projects. This lead me to wishing that I could interface with my agents in the same way that I interface with my already existing windows and editors. For me, this usually means that I have like 5 to anywhere around 8 different windows that I drag around depending on where I want to focus, this could mean I am focusing on the terminal now, or I want to test stuff in a simulator or browser; but when I go to interface with agents, I have to manage many tabs, or I have to look through a list in their native apps. This is not convenient for me, and I'm almost certain this is not convenient for many of you. That's why I built an infinite canvas, where my traditional desktop style workflow can come to life alongside my agents, I can drag them around depending on where I want my focus to be, or I can let them just pile up, like the 15 finder windows you're hiding with your browser right now. But, when I do want to go back to that thread, I will intuitively just know right where it is. I didn't stop there though, I really enjoyed the inbox style agent interface that Google shipped many months ago with Anti Gravity, but I didn't really enjoy much other than that, so, I built that in too. But, I still didn't stop there, a traditional code editor still comes in handy every once and awhile, just to read, or to tradcode, though Ret doesn't feature a VS-Code fork, yet anyways, maybe one day something similar could exist, it does feature a fairly comparable implementation, powered by the same technology, in a similar layout, just without the plugins and bloat. But, I didn't stop there either, the traditional sidebar and one centered chat is a nice experience sometimes, so I built that in too. I guess you probably can see where this is going, but that's also not where I stopped. Working on a single focused thread can be beneficial, but I am a heavy fork user, so I made it convenient to work side by side your main thread and a fork, with ambitions to expand on this in the future as I feel out how many forks or side chats are worth working on at the same time in the 'focused' view. But focus view doesn't stop there, instead of having only one chat in focus, and having to then jump back to the sidebar, I thought, well hey, browser tabs are great, so I built those in too. I know it sounds like there's a lot of things built in here, and there is, but trust me, it doesn't feel bloated at all, it feels amazing. I really think this is something that greatly benefits my productivity, and I hope that some of you also feel my excitement when trying it out.

projects.summary: 用麦当劳官方 MCP 扫了全国 337 个地级及以上行政区的 5,817 家门店，算出一个 0~100 的城市麦当劳指数。输入城市名或地址关键词，就能看到这座城市在同级城市中的排名，以及门店密度、核心区覆盖、得来速占比三个分项。项目含纯函数计算引擎、离线数据快照与自包含演示页，打开即用、不联网。 亮点 把接口限制变成产品定义，而不是硬刚：MCP 的门店接口单次固定只返回 5 家、无分页、经纬度恒为 0.0，拿不到门店总数。项目用同构关键词采样（城市名 + 区县 + 通用道路 + 通用 POI）绕开上限，并把产品语义直接定义成「只做同级别比较」，同时在页面明写拿到的是采样下界。 一道「防假精度」护栏：给近乎无差异的指标算百分位，等于把噪声放大成排名差异。实测全国 117 个共有 SKU 的挂牌价篮子相对极差只有 0.285，低于设定的 0.30 阈值，于是价格维度被降级为「只展示、不计分」。 用公开数据反向校验自己：把采样门店数逐省与公开门店数对照，量化覆盖率，并写清偏差方向 —— 门店越密的城市越容易被低估（南京实测覆盖率仅约 59%）。 工程上可直接取用：计算引擎是纯函数、零 I/O 零第三方依赖；71 项三态自测（通过 / 失败 / 跳过，「跳过」不算通过）；演示页是单文件，打开即用，不联网也不调 MCP。

projects.summary: 一代 FreeControl 是用 C# 写的（手搓，当年还没有 AI ），最近归档了。然后用 Rust + Tauri 2 + Svelte 重做了一版。 全程 AI ，无手工代码（包括官网、Cloudflare 发布、提交信息等），即使随手都能改好的 bug ，也会描述给 AI ，修改并落入 spec ，避免以后再犯，算是个人在 AI 时代快速迭代的路径探索把。 ## 简介 它就是个壳：常用参数做成控件，设备起别名统一管理，几台可以同时连，每台还能单独存一套参数。点连接之前，底部就能看到这次实际会执行的完整命令，复制出来就是现成的 scrcpy 命令行，想核对或者抄去自己用都行。 scrcpy 和 adb 没打进包里，首次使用时程序自己去下，通道有直连、内置代理，也能自己加代理地址，连不上自动换下一条，下完对一遍官方校验值。这么换来的就是体积：Windows 免安装单文件 6 MB 上下，Linux 给了 AppImage 和 deb 。对比一下，Escrcpy 同样是 scrcpy 图形前端，Electron 打包，Windows 便携版 116 MB 起。 ## 截图 ![设备页]( https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/pdone/FreeControl2/blob/main/assets/screenshots/devices.png) ![参数页]( https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/pdone/FreeControl2/blob/main/assets/screenshots/video.png) ## 仓库 https://github.com/pdone/FreeControl2 ## 官网 https://freecontrol2.pages.dev/

projects.title: Show HN: Helicon – Desktop App for Meta's Muse Code CLI (Linux, Windows, macOS)
projects.author: harjjotsinghh
projects.summary: Hi Hacker News, I'm Harjot. I've been using Meta's Muse Code CLI daily for a few weeks now. One thing that I found difficult to handle was managing or controlling multiple sessions across multiple projects, while using the terminal for the muse CLI. Initially, I used cmux to create workspaces/groups for my different projects to group them, and then created 4 split terminals in each of those projects, that ran muse code sessions in each of them. It worked, but it was ugly. I didn't like using that. It could be because I'm not really a terminal person and would much rather prefer a proper dedicated GUI or desktop/app interface, and I would prefer it any time over a terminal screen or CLI. So it might be personal preference but yeah. So, I started building a desktop app around it, mainly to scratch my own itch. Helicon is a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus a VS Code extension that also works in Cursor and Devin. It doesn't replace the CLI. It runs `muse serve` and talks to it, and it reuses your existing `muse login`, so you don't have to get an API key and you don't pay an extra bill. You can use your existing Muse Code subscription plans. Some things that I use the most: 1. Resuming sessions that I started in the terminal. I don't start many sessions in the terminal now that Helicon exists, but initially I wanted to access all the sessions that were running in a terminal to be accessible from Helicon, when it was created initially. 2. Inline diffs that I can approve, similar to how Cursor works. 3. I can clearly see my 5-hour and weekly plan limits directly from the app itself and don't have to manually keep going to Meta's Muse Code billing page and manually keep refreshing the page to see my current usage/limits. I built it using Tauri 2 and React. It is MIT licensed. I built a lot of it with AI coding agents, especially Opus 5.5 (I really like using this model). It's at v0.21.9 now, and 9 people have contributed so far. Some issues: the Windows installer isn't code-signed yet, so you'll see a SmartScreen warning. And the macOS build isn't notarized, so you need to click "Open Anyway" once. You can try it in the browser with mock data, no install needed: https://helicon.sh/try It's unofficial and not affiliated with Meta. If you use a coding CLI every day, what would you want from a GUI for it? And what would make you go back to the terminal?

projects.summary: 小篆输入法 打拼音就出篆书的 macOS 输入法，另附 Windows / 安卓的 Rime 方案和三个在线小工具。 为什么做 想写句篆书发朋友圈，得一个字一个字翻《说文》查篆形，找到还要自己拼图排版。 查了三个字就放弃了，然后花了一个月做了个输入法。 核心设计 上屏的是普通汉字，靠字体把它显示成篆形。 不是不想用篆书字符 —— 篆书在 Unicode 里是 U+3D000 往上的超 BMP 码位， 没装字体的机器上全是豆腐块，复制给别人也看不了、搜不到。 所以绕了一下：汉字上屏，字体换形。这样能复制、能搜索、换台电脑也不会变乱码。 字形来源 主体：开元小篆（11,081 个码位，SIL OFL，把《说文》公版刻本扫描描摹） 补缺：台湾全字库说文解字（OGDL-Taiwan-1.0） 三个在线小工具（纯 HTML，字体内嵌，双击即用） 篆书卡片：输入名字，出一张篆书卡片 古文字抽象画：六种「心境」对应六种画法（Brice Marden / 井上有一 / Pollock / 东巴文 / Rothko / 当代书象） 古文字表情包：六种语气的方形表情包

projects.title: Show HN: Laya guard – a local check before your coding agent runs a command
projects.author: ayaan0209
projects.summary: HN, this is my first Show HN post, and I'm really nervous, I'm Ayaan, a Frontend Developer. laya-guard is a local check that occurs before any coding agent tool call, deciding whether to approve, send for review, or block the call. When Jev was released, I was curious as to how I could use it, and I quickly discovered Laya which is an open-source 322M model that functions almost identically but runs on a laptop's CPU in under 100ms, as the check is local, there won't be a chance of 3rd parties seeing your commands, directories, or tokens, and there's no charge per call, I often work in Korean, and most of the guardrails I've seen have not evaluated Korean at all, hence why I've implemented it as well. Regex policies catch known dangerous patterns before even reaching models, any command that is blocked is never seen by models, commands like ls, git status, and npm test will skip the model altogether, unless they have pipes, chaining, redirects, -exec flags, or sensitive paths, everything else is sent to the model for processing, once you have the model downloaded, it makes decisions from a fixed set of outcomes with no API key or request needed for any external service, there are also hooks for 11 different agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and many more. And Also a local dashboard where you can see all decision and why it was made and install the hook for each agent, it doesn't save the commands themeslves. In my tests with AgentDojo, it blocked 25/27 attacks, and allowed 92/97 harmless tasks, it correctly identified 64/66 commands I made. After the Reddit post, people have found some issues with it: Adding a comment at the end of a command would fool the model to not block the command. The model only read the first 4,000 characters, so it could be spammed with junk to the beginning to bypass the check, this would send dangerous commands like curl to review. "curl" repeated 40,000 times caused one regex to run for 48 seconds, timing out the hook and running the command. All 3 issues have already been fixed, somebody also pointed out that if the server was down, commands ran without any check, now it asks you first, or blocks the command if the agent can't ask Please note that this is not a tool to check if the code written is correct, it's a tool to prevent agents from running dangerous commands.

projects.title: Show HN: Stream live open data in two commands
projects.author: gardensalad
projects.summary: A service and open source tool to get open data streams in two commands. No sign up needed for subscribing. Streams to try: - https://hypermass.io/stream/_J0fm450s - extreme UV images of the sun from SOHO - visual data - https://hypermass.io/stream/_ATtCoEK - GDACS live disaster data (filtered to just the ongoing items) The CLI (Apache 2.0, https://github.com/hypermass-io/hypermass-cli ) tool allows you to subscribe to multiple live streams of files, with the files arriving in a local folder. The filenames are ULIDs so they can be easily sorted into time order in scripts and code. Publishing works similarly - drop files into a folder and they get read, published and deleted locally. The idea is that by being highly opinionated about the shape of the data (files, delivered in sequence, in real time) a bunch of the logic and edge cases get handled well in one place (things like ordering, retries, hash verification, reconnection, etc) - rather than requiring every subscriber to implement it themselves for every source. A high-speed version for things like departure boards, train positions is in the pipeline. Background: About 10 years ago, I worked for a few years supporting and developing some of the UK Rail Open Data systems. As a developer I was frustrated at how fragmented the open data space was, and how every open data system was designed as a blank-page exercise. I realised that a lot of data falls into an odd middle ground, too infrequent to economically poll on a large scale, too large for messaging protocols, but in some sense still real time. For example transport schedules, periodic solar imagery, disaster alerts - real-time but infrequent. Fairly often I just wanted a "just give me the data" option when the solutions I found were static catalogues with no nod towards real-time use, bespoke APIs, analytics systems and other things I didn't need. I couldn't find a simple approach that leaned into what I saw as the data's strengths (simple files, delivered in order, as/when they are published) - so I built it. About me: Solo founder based in the UK, full time for just over a year. Sustainability: Initially a "heavy users pay for more data allowance" model with a decent free tier. Ideally we later shift to institutional publishers pay to keep their streams free to download. Possibly a paid data marketplace to support costs, but the main focus would always be the free and open data. What I'd like to know: - Does the CLI approach solve any real problems for you? - Is the technical approach sane? - Would you use a service like this to publish data? - Recommendations to bootstrap users (particularly publishers)?

projects.title: Show HN: Enso Method – agent skills for building software for someone else
projects.author: dwkerwin
projects.summary: The Enso Method is a new set of AI skills for Claude Code and Codex which I've open sourced on GitHub predominantly for developers who build for someone else who is making the product/business calls. I've been using AI to write basically 100% of my code since late 2024, back in the Sonnet 3.5 days, when it barely worked and there were few people doing this and very little support for this way of developing. I stubbornly thought this was going to be the future and came up with a methodology for making it work, before "AI skills" were even a thing. Since then I've continued to refine the method and I just recently published it as open source. The method focuses on requirements (PRD, TDD) up front, and has skills that autonomously refine the requirements, declaring assumptions that should be validated by stakeholders. It doesn't expect you to be a solo founder or that whoever is at the keyboard directing Claude or Codex to be the product owner and business decider in addition to being the developer. I think most of us sit in the seat where we develop for someone else who decides. And if AI is all about velocity, then if we have to slow down to get product owners to review and decide, that puts a serious damper on the efficiency everyone expects from AI development. So a defining attribute of the Enso Method is, when it reviews the requirements prior to implementation, it asks what questions/gaps there are and it tries to answer its own questions. If it can get to 95%+ confidence in the answers, it just rolls with those. If less then it will declare the assumption in an assumptions.md file which gets routed to business stakeholders to review. In the meantime however we still consider this to be a green light, we can move forward and implement with the assumptions, and if we later hear from the business that the assumption was wrong, we update the requirements and re-implement, because implementation is now cheap, and waiting isn't.

github.description: 🏭 AI 工程化交付系统 — 把完整工程团队的工序编进一条多 Agent 管线：14 角色 · 三道验证闸门 · EXIT_CODE 指纹 · 定向回环 · 三层记忆。实战产出：AgentGate（127 项测试）。

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个开源项目： 一句话：把完整工程团队的 14 个角色和工序，编成一条多 Agent 的交付管线。我不缺会用 AI 写代码的工具，缺的是「工序」——谁先谁后、什么算完成、出错了往哪退。这三个问题不解决，交付质量就只能靠运气。 这个项目的思路是把「制度」做进管线：每个角色的产出必须过三道闸门才能交给下一个角色（① 文件真实存在且非空 ② 所有验证命令必须贴出 EXITCODE——Agent 编得了话，编不了退出码 ③ 面向用户的产出过脱敏检查）；审查不通过不盲目重跑，而是按问题类型回环到对应角色；三层记忆给上下文装硬上限，防膨胀。 几个我觉得有意思的点：它不是新的 Agent 框架，而是「跑在 Agent 之上的制度」——一份可直接被 Claude Code 等编程 Agent 使用的协议集；零第三方依赖，仓库里 3 个 Demo（门禁 / 记忆 / 管线漫游）clone 下来 1 分钟跑完；最近还给它加了 RSI 自我迭代——失误登记 → 预防闸门 → 自动验证，管线会自己修自己的流程。 这是继 AgentGate（管线可靠性层）后的第二条线：一个管「点」（每个产出可不可信），这个管「面」（整条交付线有没有工序），可以配合使用。MIT 协议，欢迎拍砖。

projects.title: Show HN: shadowclone, skills learned from your coding agent corrections
projects.author: theonly1me
projects.summary: shadowclone reads the coding-agent sessions already on your disk, finds where you corrected the agent and turns those corrections into skills your agents load next time. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and Antigravity. Every capture source is off by default and has its own consent setting. Why I'm building it? I use multiple harnesses and agents, I extensively use Claud Code and Codex, but I also use Cursor and Antigravity every now and then. I didn't want to have to teach every harness or model the things I taught the other ones between my last session and the current one. I also cannot have my personal rules and preferences in all the repositories I work on because my collaborators may have varying levels of trust with AI and their own preferences. shadowclone helps me build and improve trust with my agents so I can give them more autonomy while running multiple sessions in parallel. --- Who is this for? If you only use Claude or Codex or any one of these, you may not need the shadowclone CLI and the harness and agent you use might already be sufficient. But, if you are like me and work across harnesses and agents, shadowclone will help you avoid repeating your preferences each time. --- Built-in skills and skill builds shadowclone is also great for someone who is just now adopting AI into their coding workflows because it ships with several skills that they can use to customize their agent's behavior. They can equip all the skills, or just some of them, they'll see the "personality" their agent gets from equipping those skills from the `shadowclone wizard`. --- Setup is extremely easy, just ask your Claude Code, or Codex, or another agent - "Set up shadowclone: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theonly1me/shadowclone/mai... " --- Privacy shadowclone is free and open source, it uses the MIT license. It doesn't have a subscription, or a server. It just uses your existing agent subscription i.e. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, or even your local model via Pi. You can explicitly disable sources, it also redacts any and all sensitive information it uses for learning. --- PR reviews and Cloud bots It can review PRs with the `shadowclone review` command, it ships a guided review skill that will perform a deep review of your code (or someone else's) and produce an HTML document you can annotate, add comments to and submit so your agent can stage a draft review on the PR you are reviewing. --- Evals I performed several evals, I won't describe them here, all of them are available in the repository - https://github.com/theonly1me/shadowclone/tree/main/evals --- Comparison to other tools? You can also see how it compares to other tools here - https://github.com/theonly1me/shadowclone/tree/main#how-shad...

projects.title: Show HN: Hapsland – Realtime semantic advice on coding standards for the agents
projects.author: Firfi
projects.summary: Agents ignore AGENTS.md mid-session. Then you tell them: hey, this is written in AGENTS.md. - "You're absolutely right!" (proceeds with fixing) But not anymore! This is a tool that would check the code immediately with a classifier (Jev etc.) and give the agent advice in the same turn. It catches some mistakes that are difficult to put into lint rules and excels at the cases when semantic understanding is required - e.g. field names/types in a nested structure that contradict each other (more commonly known as "invalid states") (that we strive to make, e.g. "unrepresentable", some would say) Even reviewer agent loops won't do much (as Primeagen's X post a month ago shows in all the colours [which I don't know if I can or can not link, and will stay on the safe side of not doing so]). This may or may not have an influence in nerd sniping me into writing that tool. In cases like these, Hapsland (or its approach, at least) comes to help. I know, I know, Abide (look it up!) exists, but I wanted (a) semantic expansion of code (b) full control over what's sent to Jev (hey, their ToS aren't that privacy-friendly) (c) less footprint on the file system. So I made it compatible. In case you want to use both, I mean. TLDR: catch a change with a coding agent hook => expand it into semantic code structure, respecting privacy settings => call Jev with your own code semantic rules => deliver feedback to the agent in the same turn, in 0.5s. P.S. This is a repost from last week when I was being a genius; I forgot to add "Show HN:" to the title, and then 30m passed and I couldn't delete that post anymore; renaming didn't put it into Show HN either.

github.name: robertn702/reasoning-router
github.description: Per-step reasoning effort for coding agents, picked by a classifier, without breaking the prompt cache. OpenCode plugin, Pi extension, and a local proxy for Codex CLI.

projects.summary: 我一直把编程 Agent 的推理强度开在 high，连改名这种小事也是，用量消耗得很快。但降到 medium 又会出错：在一个较难的 pytest bug 上，GPT-6 Astra 用 medium 5 次只解决了 1 次。 所以我做了 reasoning-router。编程 Agent 每次请求模型之前，它先让一个小型分类器（默认是 TypeSafe 的 Jev，也可以换成 Cloudflare Clef、Laya 等）判断这一步需要多少推理强度，再把结果加到请求里。 切换推理强度通常会让 prompt cache 失效。它用 OpenAI 的 configurationupdate 和 Anthropic 的对话中 effort 消息来改强度，之前的上下文不变，所以缓存还能命中。 在 10 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上，路由和固定 high 都解决了 44/44，路由少用约 14% 的输出 token，耗时少约 9%。只测了一个模型和一组任务，结果仅供参考。 支持 OpenCode 插件、Pi 扩展，以及可接入 Codex CLI 的本地代理。目前是 alpha 版本，MIT 协议。

projects.title: Show HN: PanamaKVM – direct-booting Linux from Java 25 via FFM/KVM
projects.author: rusanoph
projects.summary: Hi HN! PanamaKVM is an experimental miniVM containing the bare minimum components needed to boot an x86 Linux kernel and run an interactive terminal. Its key feature is that it is built on top of Java 25 without using JNI. Instead, it utilizes the Foreign Function & Memory API (FFM). I generally stick to Java LTS versions - having worked with Java 21 for a long time - so I recently decided to check if any new LTS releases had come out. It turns out I was a year late to the party regarding Java 25. While looking through the changelog, I noticed the new FFM for native code and decided to give it a try. As it turned out, I was a couple of years late to the FFM feature :D, since it had already been introduced as a full-fledged part of the language in Java 22. One interesting thing I discovered during implementation was a quirk in the ioctl ABI: there seemed to be a discrepancy between the KVM API documentation and the actual implementation. The very first call I attempted was KVM_GET_API_VERSION, but it unexpectedly returned EINVAL. After tracing the execution with strace, I managed to pinpoint the root cause (which was nearly impossible to debug at the Java level): the call was reaching the kernel without a third argument (whereas the documentation specified two). As it turns out, when the KVM documentation says an ioctl takes no arguments, it actually does require one... Due to KVM's implementation details, it implicitly expects a third parameter - it just has to be zero. This is likely to prevent reading garbage data from memory. Perhaps some readers have insights into the underlying reason for this difference - or maybe it was just human error and "things just turned out that way." In any case, by following the instructions in the repository's README, you can boot a functional Linux kernel and interact with it via the terminal. I’ve only tested the launch using Alpine 3.24.2 x86-64 on WSL2, so that might be a limitation. However, if you run it on a different setup or on bare-metal Linux, that would be great - please let me know. And if something breaks in the process - even better - let me know about that too. As for what I haven't finished yet in the current virtual machine implementation: networking and persistent storage are missing, and there is no virtio integration. Multi-vCPU startup mode isn't supported either; essentially, the creation of a single vCPU is currently hardcoded. I’d also love to hear your thoughts on the project. I would particularly value any feedback regarding the use of FFM and the KVM API itself. I’ll be happy to answer any questions you have.

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-windows 它是一个挂在聊天窗口旁边的回复辅助：对聊天窗口截图，用本地离线 OCR 读屏上的对话，把文字交给 Jev 判断意图和情绪，给出 3 条候选回复，点一下填进输入框——发送永远由你自己按。 技术上有两个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 采集层完全不侵入聊天软件：按窗口 ID 截图（不是全屏），OCR 在本地离线完成，不注入、不 hook、不解密任何聊天数据库。判断层走 TypeSafe Jev，起草层接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。 2. 分发做成了"下载即用"：Releases 里有打包好的 exe（约 146 MB），普通用户不用装 Python；API key 只写 Windows 用户环境变量（注册表 HKCU\Environment），不落任何文件，其余设置放在 exe 旁边的 config.json，整个文件夹拷走设置也跟着走。 Windows 10 (1903+) / 11 可用，开源在 GitHub，exe 未签名（SmartScreen 会拦一下，介意可以自己打包）。 适合聊天量大、想先看懂对方意图再回复的 Windows 用户，也欢迎研究离线 OCR + 窗口感知管线的同学看源码。

projects.title: [开源自荐] 小喷 1.1.0： Mac 菜单栏语音伙伴，支持 ChatGPT 订阅和本机 Ollama
projects.author: AvalonKing
projects.summary: 我是小喷作者。这是我业余维护的原生 macOS 菜单栏语音助手，刚发布 1.1.0 ，代码采用 MIT 协议。想解决一个小需求：手在键盘上时，顺口查天气、定计时器或调音量，不用先找聊天窗口。 叫一声“小喷小喷”就能开始，回答后可以继续追问。提醒保存在本机；提醒和音量指令由本机解析执行，不依赖模型工具调用。普通问答使用你选择的大模型，并流式朗读。 技术上使用 Swift 6 / SwiftUI 。唤醒词用 macOS 本机语音识别；模型入口按服务商、通用接口、本机三组管理，各自保存配置，密钥和登录令牌放钥匙串。可以接自己的 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容 API 、已有的 ChatGPT 订阅，或本机 Ollama 。应用免费下载，第三方模型和云端识别可能收费，ChatGPT 订阅受账户额度限制。 服务商目录集中定义协议、地址与模型预设，方便扩展；与模型有关的特殊参数单独处理。对本机技能，我更在意执行后能确认实际结果，例如调音量后重新读取设备状态，设备不支持时直接提示。 1.1.0 加了回声消除和直接开口打断，也能设成唤醒词打断。蓝牙耳机暂不支持语音打断，可用 ⌥⌘K 。朗读可选系统声音，或下载约 3.1 GB 的 Qwen3-TTS 在本机 GPU 运行。 隐私边界：默认叫醒后，含唤醒前约 2.5 秒的录音会发到千问做识别；直接说话打断时，也会发送约 1 秒预录及后续插话确认人声。可以切换本机识别。识别出的聊天文字发给所选模型，对话只留在内存；天气查询会向 Open-Meteo 发送城市或粗略坐标。 需要 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon 。当前安装包尚未经过苹果公证，首次安装有额外门槛，请先看安装说明。 [代码与安装说明]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac#安装) · [1.1.0 下载]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac/releases/tag/v1.1.0) · [隐私说明]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md) 欢迎试用和提 Issue ，尤其想听听唤醒、断句和连续对话在哪些场景还不自然。

projects.title: [开源推荐] 让 AI 自己打断点：通用的 Java 远程调试 Agent Skill
projects.author: Aresxue

github.name: Aresxue/java-debug-skill
github.description: A Java remote breakpoint debugging Skill for AI agents such as Claude Code. It attaches to a remote JVM with JDWP enabled. The AI plans and sets breakpoints, waits for hits, collects call stacks and local variables, evaluates expressions and single-steps. It then reports a root cause based only on runtime data it actually collected.

projects.summary: java-debug 是一个 Java 远程断点调试 Agent Skill（标准 SKILL.md 格式），Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等支持 Skills 的 Agent 都能用。它会连接开启了 JDWP 的远程 JVM，由 AI 自行规划断点、等待命中，采集调用栈和局部变量，执行表达式求值和单步，最后根据实际采集到的运行时数据给出根因结论，而不是对着日志猜。核心是自研的 JDI 客户端：只依赖 JDK 内置的 com.sun.jdi，零外部依赖，以常驻 HTTP 服务模式运行，每个操作都是一条 JSON 命令，用 curl 就能驱动。 亮点 为 AI 驱动重新设计：jdb 输出的是文本，要靠 tmux + sleep 抢时序，而且默认冻结整个 JVM。这里改为 SUSPENDEVENTTHREAD，只冻结命中的线程；请求和响应都是结构化 JSON，命中时自动带回调用栈和局部变量，等待命中是带超时的阻塞等待。 断点不漏装：类还没加载时自动转为延迟断点；重载方法、同一行的多个可执行位置（包括 lambda）都会装上；多 ClassLoader 和热部署场景下，同名类的每个副本都装断点，之后加载的副本也会自动补装。 安全边界写成硬约束：命令端口只绑定 127.0.0.1，会校验 Host 头并拒绝浏览器跨站请求；eval 内置拒绝名单（System.exit、Runtime.exec 等）；命中时从不自动调用 toString()；disconnect 后被冻结的线程全部恢复。工作流还要求断点计划先经用户确认，结束时必须 disconnect。

projects.summary: autopilot 是一个 Claude Code / Codex 插件（MIT）：你给一个目标，它自动规划、实现、验收、合并，再把经验沉淀进项目知识库。 造它是因为 AI 写码的两个真实教训：我碰到过 864 个测试全绿、页面输入框却根本不能用的版本；也抓到过一张截图被复制 7 份、冒充 7 个验收证据。测试数量在涨，证据质量没涨——所以我把「验收」做进了循环： 红蓝对抗：蓝队负责实现，红队看不到蓝队的做法，拿目标盲测找茬，更接近真实质检； 证据闸门：每个验收谓词都要有真实产物，没有产物的 PASS 会被机械判 FAIL，专治 AI「报喜不报忧」； 知识工程：任务结束后把踩坑经验自动沉淀进项目知识库，下个任务开局就带上。 这不是为了开源而开源：过去 6.5 个月我自己的活全跑在它上面，迭代了 146 个版本、380+ 个 commits（其中 84% 与 AI 结对完成）。

github.description: 聊天悬浮窗助手（macOS）：屏幕感知 + 本地小模型判断意图与风险，按话术生成回复候选。纯只读。

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-mac 它是一个 macOS 悬浮窗：聊天应用里弹出一条消息，悬浮窗会告诉你这句话的真实意图（8 类，零样本 86.4%）、风险分级（0-9 分）和几条候选回复，点「填入」进输入框——发送键永远由你自己按。 技术上有几个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 感知层没有侵入任何聊天应用：要么对前台聊天窗口按窗口 ID 截图（不是全屏），再用 Apple Vision OCR 只扫聊天区，按气泡和左右对齐区分正文、昵称、固定公告和引用；要么直接走系统文本接口读，不截图不 OCR。 2. 判断层是个本地 2B 小模型，一次前向同时出 8 类意图的全分布和风险分级，下载后完全离线；也可以配 TypeSafe Jev 的 key 走云端。生成层接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点（DeepSeek、智谱、本地 Ollama 都实测过），14 种话术并发生成候选，再由本地模型重排。M1 Pro 上出意图约 1.5 秒。 3. 坚持只读不代发：不模拟任何按键——合成输入事件会被部分应用的账号风控识别；「填入」优先走辅助功能接口写入并读回确认，定位不到就复制到剪贴板让你自己粘贴。 用法：Releases 下载 .app 拖进应用程序，授予屏幕录制权限即可。仅支持 Apple Silicon（M 系列）+ macOS 13+，MIT 开源。 适合每天在微信/飞书/QQ 里打字很多、想先看懂对方再回复的人，以及研究屏幕感知 + 端侧小模型落地的同学。

projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一下我一个人维护的开源项目 Sax Design Vue：基于 Vue3 和 TypeScript 的 UI 组件库，最近发布了 2.1.0，MIT 协议。 Vuesax 的 Vue3 版本停止持续更新后，我想尝试把它复活。做着做着，又决定在原有视觉语言上做点更大胆、更不一样的东西：让它既能做出有辨识度的界面，也能承接复杂数据业务与 Agent 应用。表格的功能和交互参考了 vxe-table，感谢这两个项目带来的启发。 特色目录 | 能力 | 值得一看的地方 | | --- | --- | | 基于路由的 Anchor | 同一份目录混合路由章节和页内锚点；支持页首 / 页尾继续滚动切换章节，以及相邻路由预取。 | | 动态行高与双向虚拟表格 | 根据内容测量实际行高，配合行列虚拟化和按索引数据源；固定列、多级表头等业务能力仍可组合使用。 | | Form / Table 共享渲染器 | 同一份渲染器定义服务于单元格展示、编辑、表单与筛选，复用标准控件和业务规则。 | | 14 个 Agent 交互组件 | 覆盖输入、消息、流式输出、推理步骤、引用、计划审批等过程；模型能力通过数据配置联动。 | | 液态镜片 Card | 用 SVG 滤镜实现背景折射，材质、布局和交互效果可以独立组合。 | | 弧形与 3D Carousel | 弧形扇面、卡片层叠、环形轨道和棱柱展示，共用导航、拖动和自动播放能力。 | | 暗水印与截图显影 | 除明水印外，也能生成低可见度的暗水印，并提供截图显影示例。 | | 声明式 Skeleton | 用圆、方块、长条与嵌套行的简易配置组合骨架屏，避免每种布局都手写占位结构。 | 下面用几个实际示例介绍其中的重点。 1. 有自己的美术风格 延续 Vuesax 的设计语言，以无边框、圆角、柔和阴影和渐变建立层次，强调卡片、控件、浮层之间的一致性；支持浅色 / 深色主题，也提供玻璃材质、气泡纹理进度条等视觉能力。 输入、选择、反馈和弹出层都沿用这套视觉语言，配合霓虹文字、材质和动效做一点大胆的尝试。 2. 表格的业务能力与大数据渲染一起做 Table 在同一个组件中提供多级表头、固定列、树形与分组、汇总、合并单元格、编辑校验、变更跟踪、查找替换、行列拖拽，以及查询表单、工具栏和请求代理。Form 与 Table 共用渲染器机制，常见输入与操作可以通过配置复用。 动态行高会按内容自动测量，支持换行文本与不同高度的行，并与行列虚拟化配合，不要求每一行都写死高度。 性能方面支持行列双向虚拟化和按索引数据源 virtualSource。虚拟化减少 DOM；索引数据源进一步避免为了描述巨量逻辑行列而先创建完整数组。 下面是文档中的 10 万行 × 10 万列逻辑数据示例，支持在起点、中部和末端之间跳转，只读取当前窗口，并保留固定列。它表示逻辑规模，不会一次创建或渲染全部单元格。文档还提供百万行生成源的校验与图表取数示例。 可以直接体验：表格基础 · 编辑与校验 · 虚拟化与大数据 3. 内置 14 个常用 Agent 交互组件 覆盖聊天输入、角色消息、消息虚拟滚动、聊天历史、流式文本、推理步骤、引用、代码块、文件差异、任务列表、计划审批、问题卡片、图像生成状态和 Agent Editor。 聊天输入：文件选择与图片预览、语音输入入口、模型选择、Fast 和思考强度设置；模型能力由应用传入，切换模型时联动可用选项。 消息与输出：用户 / Agent 的不同布局和操作，动态行高虚拟滚动、历史懒加载、流式展示和引用。 执行过程：推理步骤、任务列表、可展开的计划与批准反馈，以及收集用户回答的问题卡片。 这些组件负责界面和交互，模型服务及业务流程由应用接入。可以从现成组件开始组合，而不必逐个重写聊天与执行过程的基础 UI。 项目提供中英文文档、可运行示例、代码查看与在线 Playground。

projects.title: Show HN: Lemma, an IDE for reading mathematics (macOS, open source)
projects.author: fus3r
projects.summary: I built Lemma while working through The Elements of Statistical Learning (using the Preview app). Kept running into references like "(3.41)" or "by Theorem 2.3" forcing me to scroll back through the entire book. And whenever a proof wasn’t detailed enough, I'd screenshot it, ask ChatGPT to explain, then go back to the PDF to add manual notes. Got pretty annoying. That led me to Lemma: it reads a PDF once (locally), lets you jump around between equations, theorems, etc. without constantly scrolling. I gave it a VS Code look because yes, I'm addicted to VS Code (there are other themes for normal people). A non-exhaustive list of things it can do (right now): - References to theorems, equations, figures, citations and index entries are all clickable (you can peek at them without leaving the page) - You can ask an agent or ChatGPT Web for explanations, longer proofs with one click, save the output in Lemma - When the pdf says “it is easy to show” or “proof left to the reader”, you can write the missing steps in LaTeX, and Lemma checks it on random numerical inputs and gives counterexamples if it’s wrong. You can also fold proofs to try them yourself first, and keep notes attached to specific passages (with exports to Markdown, Anki and Jupyter). Built in Swift/SwiftUI using PDFKit. The analysis runs in a helper process at low priority. No account, no telemetry, and it's GPL. It’s for macOS 15+ only for now (unless a lot of people find it useful, then I’ll probably do it for other OSes). It still struggles with some PDFs (scanned ones, other languages, different numbering, etc.) If you try it on whatever you're reading and encounter some problems, feel free to open an issue!

projects.title: 整了个多 agent 协作工具 Sealwire：让 Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode 等 Agent 互相 review、合作，手机上审批接管（送测试码）
projects.author: randomname123
projects.summary: 大家好，我是 Yk ，在 V2EX 一般只看帖，不怎么回复。这次分享一下自己天天在用的工具，希望能得到大家的反馈。 平时上班的时候或者下班 vibe ，都会 Claude Code/Codex/Cursor 混着用，一直有两个痛点： 1. 不同模型交互会有困难，经常需要我复制粘贴对话或者说一样的话； 2. 长任务卡让他们交互经常需要我来指引。 所以基于自己的工作流做了 Sealwire ，一个多 agent 协作工具。自己已经用了半年，感觉比较稳定了，发点测试码给有需要的朋友。 产品的初衷是能够花更少时间呆在电脑前面等待 Agent ，能有更多时间思考产品和陪伴家人。 演示视频： https://youtu.be/38TT8iX9Oqw 目前支持 - 支持五种 Harness：Claude Code 、Codex 、Cursor 、OpenCode 、Pi - 跨 agent review：/review ，你可以让一个 agent 审另外一个 agent 的改动。 - /goal 让 agent 自己跑到完成，/delegate 把支线任务丢给另一个 agent 。 - 默认是本地隐私模式。 - Cloud 模式下手机浏览器同一会话：PWA + 推送，可以远程审批，所有消息默认远程端到端加密。 https://i.imgur.com/vSD59A3.png https://i.imgur.com/9VWAj0g.png 如何开始：在项目目录跑 npx sealwire 说明： - 协议：PolyForm Internal Use + 个人使用许可，源码公开方便安全审计。个人和公司内部免费使用，不允许分发。详情请参考 Github 的 license 说明。 - 手机远程需要 SealWire Cloud access key ，用手机浏览器打开 https://app.sealwire.dev 即可。需要的朋友可以在帖子里回复 base64 编码后的邮箱，或者发邮件到 sealwire.dev@gmail.com （注明 V2EX ），我会发一年有效的 key 。目前短期内暂无收费计划。 - 目前只支持 macOS / Linux 。 - 接下来计划支持基于代码库上下文的语音输入，以及 iOS app 。 GitHub： https://github.com/sealwire/sealwire 问题和建议欢迎提 issue 或在帖子里回复，特别想听听大家对跨 agent review 流程的看法，以及你们平时管理多个 agent 的痛点。

github.description: iOS 键盘：在任何聊天 App 里直接出意图、风险与候选回复——复制消息，键盘上见分晓。Swift / SwiftUI，中英双语。An iOS keyboard that drafts replies inside any chat app.

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-ios（iOS 键盘版） 它是一个 iOS 自定义键盘：在任何聊天 App 里，长按复制对方那条消息，切到 Jev 键盘点「分析剪贴板」，键盘上直接给出这句话的意图（8 类概率分布）、风险分级（0-9）、行动建议和候选回复，点一下候选文字就进输入框。不跳 App、不切后台、不申请录屏权限——一个键盘打通所有聊天软件。 技术上有两个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 判断层走 TypeSafe Jev 的 systemone 接口，一次调用同时拿到 8 类意图的概率分布和 0-9 风险分布，还给候选回复排序；没配 key 也不会挂，自动退化成只起草的"盲起草"。生成层是标准 OpenAI 兼容 / Anthropic 兼容接口，智谱、DeepSeek、OpenRouter 都有预设，12 种话术并发各出 2 条（前稳后放）。 2. 键盘扩展有 60MB 内存上限，整个键盘是在这个约束下用纯系统控件搭的；App 和键盘共用的判断口径（意图集、风险量表、话术库、prompt）收在 Shared/ 目录单一实现里，用 swiftc 就能在 Mac 上跑口径回归，不需要 iPhone。 隐私边界：文字只在你点「分析」那一刻发往你自己配置的接口，无自建服务器、不落盘、不进日志；Key 存本机 App Group 私有容器；键盘不监听、不上传按键。发送永远由你手动完成。 Swift 5 + SwiftUI，iOS 16+，MIT 开源，Xcode 免费个人账号就能真机跑。

projects.title: Show HN: Tracon (air traffic control for subagents)
projects.author: allocate
projects.summary: My Claude Code workflow usually involves... a lot of subagents. I make one Opus model coordinate work as my tech lead, it dispatches subagents using models appropriate for the task into their own git worktrees, and then I try to multitask and do something else while they run. I'd been finding lately (particularly with Opus 5.5) that there was a ton of drift and instances of subagents not doing anything and it was evading the attention of the TL despite the instructions I gave it to have them report in at a regular cadence. Running tracon in a split terminal is my new personal workflow. It gives me early indicators when things start going off the rails (ex. blocked on a prompt, idle, looping on a failing command, simultaneous edits to files other subagents are editing, drifting off the brief, etc.) and I can interrogate the subagent's workflow and by pressing n the main agent gets a note to make a call on how and if to correct it. Read-only and runs on your machine: it tails transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/ and checks each worktree with ps, lsof, and git -- only thing that leaves your machine is what the Haiku judge reads for classification (or optionally you can turn that off with --no-judge). I've found it super useful for the game I'm building and figured others in the community might also find it useful. If you just want to give it a spin without committing: uvx tracon --demo macOS and Linux, Python 3.12+, MIT. (Not affiliated with Anthropic.)

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源的 Agent Native 应用运行时：MIAO。 它面向"给团队搭内部业务工具"这个场景：用自然语言描述要做的事，由服务器端 Agent 帮你搭出带数据表、页面、权限、状态流程的应用，预览确认后发布，团队直接使用。与常见低代码拖拽平台不同，MIAO 是 agent-first 的——界面和数据由 API 强制鉴权，AI 凭证只留在服务端，浏览器里的助手只是 API 客户端。 单个 Go 二进制自托管，内嵌 PocketBase 0.40，含 UI、迁移和备份/恢复，无需 Node.js 或独立数据库。 已发布的应用支持多页面、关联、附件、确认式业务操作，还能生成只读公开链接分享给外部。 支持按时间、记录变化或外部事件触发后台任务，采集脚本带预算和幂等回执。 Apache-2.0 许可证，安装脚本支持 Linux/macOS x64/ARM64。 官网 · 在线体验 · 源码与下载 披露：我是项目维护者，希望能作为周刊工具推荐候选。

projects.summary: 我对象做学术，经常需要把带动画的 PPT 转成 PDF。但直接导出时，原本要随着点击一步步出现的内容，可能挤在同一页，公式、图表和结论的讲述顺序就乱了。 所以我 vibe coding 搓了 Slides Bloom：把 PPT 中支持的点击进入动画，按顺序展开成 PDF 页面。 举个例子：一页学术汇报 PPT 起初只有标题，点击第 1 次出现研究问题，第 2 次出现公式，第 3 次出现结论。转换后的 PDF 会有连续 4 页：只有标题；标题加研究问题；再加公式；最后加上结论。之前出现的内容会一直保留，读 PDF 时也能跟着原来的讲述顺序往下看 上传 .pptx 后，可以在线逐页预览，再下载 PDF。 欢迎有同样需求的朋友试试： 🔗 线上体验： 💻 如果大家有兴趣，欢迎体验和提出建议，也欢迎提 Issue 或 PR 😊

You can use something like Blender, but it's heavy to install and slow to render. So we made ManimGX: - Lightweight: a 65–110 MB download, depending on the OS - Easy to install: pip install manimgx (Python 3.13+), with no system dependencies - Cross-platform: macOS, Windows and Linux, and even the browser via Pyodide and WebGPU - Blazingly fast: a Rust + wgpu engine, 90.6× faster than Manim CE and 18.7× faster than Blender Workbench, from launch to finished MP4 - Compatible with Manim Community Edition's API, with LaTeX and Typst math built in Now it's much easier for anyone with a coding agent to make 3D computer graphics videos. Repo: https://github.com/academa-labs/manimgx Docs: https://manimgx.academa.ai X post: https://x.com/sinaatalay/status/2109045945149395421 Happy to answer any questions!

projects.title: Show HN: Quaesito: a self-hosted app for quiz nights with friends
projects.author: ggirelli
projects.summary: Hi, I built Quaesito, a self-hosted quiz-night app for playing with friends. I thought it might be useful to others, so I wanted to share it here: https://github.com/ggirelli/quaesito It runs on your laptop, which you can cast or screen-share on to a TV. Friends then connect and answer from their phones, as long as everyone is on the same local network. It support Windows, macOS, and Linux, although I have only tested it on Linux so far, so feedback on the other platforms would be very welcome. I was especially careful to make it work over your local network. No requests are sent to third-party services. I wanted something that made quiz nights more fun than just a slideshow or a PDF, with support for different types of question formats and multimedia. I have plenty of ideas for additional formats, but I wanted to keep the first release manageable. The project was built entirely through vibe-coding, using Claude Code in an iterative process. I have released it under the MIT license and would appreciate any feedback, particularly from people who try running an actual quiz night with it. Hope you find it useful, and have as much fun with it as I have! Original post from my blog: https://ggirelli.info/blog/2026/10/11/quaesito

projects.title: 关于自己的 agent-harness 的实践与迭代过程中一些好玩的点
projects.author: woodchen
projects.summary: > 无广告,手打,比较乱. 我是看代码, 翻到哪写哪. 为了避免任何意义上的广告或泄露行为(基本自用, 不想找麻烦), 我会打码比较多, 见谅. > 现在当 claude 限速了, 改点小玩意, 会试试自己的. 大任务还是不太放心. 其实基本就是现在 agent 的 harness 框架,大部分都是抄 codex 和 claude code 的理论和方法. 桌面端用 wails 写的. 有时候我会问 claude 它自己有哪些工具,可以放到我的 agent (笑) ## 先放几个图 ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6c0983.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6c5247.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6dae1b.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a68ead8.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a69a776.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65a6d75e0.png) ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca65fc23aa9.png) ## 主要理论 ### 给 agent 的 tool 这个是基础, 比如`ask_user_choice`, `memory`, `call_mcp`, `workspace`, `read image`, `save file`, `send file`等等, 没有 tool 就啥都干不了. ### 调用 tool 的方法 一般是 round trip, 让 agent 可以循环, 下一步做什么让 agent 自己决定. ### tool 的反馈 tool 要给 result, 无论任何情况, 比如停止, 暂停, 错误, 成功等等, 不然 agent 无法知道情况, 无法继续. ### agent 进程要能后台运行 不能必须在页面才能运行, 以前是通过前端去反馈 result, 给后端持续调用. 发现不行, 如果切换到没挂载组件的任何前端其他页面, 都会导致任务暂停, 不如做本机程序后端去持续进行, 需要用户干预 or 完成时, 发系统级通知. ### 避免失控,人为干预, 推理记忆 1. agent 要有上限, 每次运行都有交付, 我理想的是以后不设硬上限, 交给 decisions 模型去判断. 2. 人为干预: 重要操作需要人来把控(例如可用 ask_user_choice), 人的指令高于 agent 的规划. 所以人可以主动干预计划, 停止工作等. 3. 推理记忆: 这个不能丢, 不然 agent 老是忘事.思维链和工具调用要对应, 不然会混乱. ### 四重记忆 这个我没做 harness 框架和桌面端时就做了, 纯网页对话也需要记忆. 之前好像发过贴, 忘了, 基本就是普通的 rag 4 重记忆. **只要不要影响缓存前缀就好了, 不然缓存总是丢成本很高** ### 上下文工程 正好提到缓存, agent 里要注意静态缓存和动态内容, 需要剥离. - prompt 需要分层组装. - 上下文压缩要渐进式 - 工具也是渐进披露, 不然一次性塞上下文, 占的太多, 大部分在某些工作中用不上, 还影响注意力. ### 网页端的话, 需要远程沙箱 网页端也需要提供 office 三件套文件的生成功能, 一般都是 skills+ai 写 python 脚本来实现. 这个脚本, 我是用 **远程机器(非项目主机器) + 固定容器(提供接口, 可唤起临时容器) + 临时容器(一次性执行沙箱, 做完销毁)** 来跑的. 很有必要, 放本机跑=等死. ### 本机运行环境 在桌面端安装后一段时间, 安装一个自己用的 python 独立环境. 不用机器上的主 python. ### 生态互通 claude, codex 的已有工具, 提示词, 通通都要能用, 可以无缝接入. 也就是还懒得做, 不然可以把 claude 的 memory 文档都自动给导入, 更无缝, 严丝合缝. ### 安全工程 主要就是防止任何情况的外部信息影响 agent 安全. 毕竟 agent 是在本地电脑跑的. 方方面面, 每个环节都需要加. ## 结语 下面这个图是让 claude 给我写的. 擦, 他说我后端 api 有一些 one-api 的影子, 不能写 api 部分全自研, 改成了"重新设计实现". 很尊重版权和事实了. 实际基本把 one-api 原有代码改了 70%以上了, 居然还能认出来. ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca6b0723a82.png) --- 做这个主要是兴趣, 做了一个能用的工具, 当它帮我写代码和调 mcp 发文章, 在老婆电脑上装一下用于排查电脑故障等等时, 很有成就感.

projects.author: MarkWang90

github.name: MarkWang90/mcd-memory-can
github.description: 麦当劳 MCP 订单可视化 · WorkBuddy 开发的九幕长卷生成器 —— 调用麦当劳中国官方 MCP 只读接口 order-list，把历史订单做成《重庆森林》质感的九幕图文长卷（1080×1440 竖图 / 长图 / PDF）

projects.summary: 麦当劳中国开放了官方 MCP，里面有一个只读接口 order-list，能取到自己的历史订单。 这个项目做的事情是：把取回来的订单数据，生成一套《重庆森林》质感的九幕图文长卷（1080×1440 竖图 / 一张长图 / PDF）—— 第一顿点了什么、去过最多的门店、重复最多次的组合、最长的空窗期、某一天之后频率忽然变了。 两个实现上有点意思的地方： 1. order-list 官方固定只返回最近 10 单，拿不到全量历史。解法是每天跑一次快照、累积去重， 跑得越久数据越全（现在这份数据是四个月攒出来的）。 2. 「算不出来的那一幕会被整页丢掉」——数据凑不齐的那一页直接不生成，文案里不编造任何一个数字。 所以有人拿到六页，有人拿到九页。 全程只读、不上传任何数据；零第三方依赖，只用标准库和官方 MCP。 不想接 Token 也能玩：有个纯前端网页版，点一下随机生成一套自洽的数字， 直接在浏览器里画出一卷可以下载的 PNG（画面全部由 Canvas 现画，不依赖任何图片素材）：

projects.summary: 面向 AI 编程 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）用户的免费工具包（MIT）。思路是每次会话结束时留一份结构化交接记录——目标状态、关键决策及原因、动过的文件、未闭环事项、下一步动作——让下一次会话或接手的另一个 Agent 从事实出发，而不是从已经塞满过期探索的上下文里硬撑。包含一个可直接安装的 Agent Skill、一页上下文维护清单和一份填空模板。 亮点 1. 即装即用的 Agent Skill：SKILL.md 可直接装入 Agent 的 skills 目录，上下文快满或会话结束时按固定结构产出交接记录（目标状态、决策与原因、涉及文件、未闭环事项、下一步）。 2. 上下文维护清单：context-hygiene-checklist.md 一页讲清何时 /clear、何时 /compact、何时直接开新会话，并给出重置前的 2 分钟例行动作。 3. 填空模板：handoff-template.md 每节带填写指引，既可由 Agent 自动生成，也可人工手写补录。

projects.title: 把 Tripo Studio 连接到 Codex 的插件
projects.author: bugyaluwang
projects.summary: ![Tripo Studio for Codex Banner]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.png) 为什么是 **Link your Tripo Studio**，而不是 **Tripo API**？ 最近在用 Codex 写自己的 3D / 游戏项目时，我发现现有的官方工具只支持 Tripo API： 1. **明明开了网页端会员，调 API 还得再交一份钱**：很多创作者和独立开发者手里本来就有 **Tripo Studio 网页端会员**（每个月有大量套餐积分），但官方 API Key 的计费池是完全独立的——想在 Agent 里自动化生成模型，还得额外掏钱充值 API Credits 。 2. **我们需要的是整个「 Studio 工作流」，而不是裸调一个无状态接口**：做 3D 资产不是发个 Prompt 拿回一个 URL 就完事了。以往我们要在「浏览器输入 Prompt ➔ 手动下载 GLB ➔ 拖进 Blender 查面数和流形 ➔ 姿势不对切回网页重刷 ➔ 绑骨骼调动作 ➔ 导出 FBX 塞进工程目录」之间反复横跳。 所以我做了一个开源的 Codex 插件 —— **[Tripo Studio for Codex]( https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin)**（ MIT License ），刚刚发布了最新的 **v0.3.4** 版本。 它不走额外的 API Key 计费中转，而是**直接把你的 Tripo Studio 网页端账号、完整创作管线、可视化工作台以及本地 Blender 后处理引擎，原封不动地连进了 Codex**。 --- ### 💡 连入 Tripo Studio 意味着什么？ #### 1. BYO Studio Account：直接复用网页端会员与积分，零 API 溢价 插件直接复用本机的 Tripo Studio 网页登录会话，无需申请和购买 API Key 。你在网页端订购的会员积分，现在可以直接在 Codex 对话框里调用 Studio 全套最新算力： - **High Detail (H2.5 / H3.0 / H3.1)**：高精度几何建模 + 2K/4K/8K PBR 材质与局部重绘 - **Smart Mesh P2**：严格控制在 500–25,000 面的规整四边面网格，支持单次生成多个面数预算变体 - **多视角对齐建模**：支持正/左/背/右四视图一致建模 - **Rig V3 绑骨 & AI Motion**：自动适配 Mixamo / UE Mannequin / Unity Humanoid 标准骨架，支持文本生成连贯动作并重定向 #### 2. 不止是对话：68 个 MCP 工具 + 内嵌 Studio 可视化工作台（ MCP Apps ） 纯靠聊天调 3D 参数像开盲盒，纯靠点网页 UI 又没法让 Agent 帮你批量干活并直接写入代码仓库。基于 **Codex MCP Apps**，我们把 Studio 界面直接搬进了 Codex： - **三合一内嵌工作台**：随时在聊天中唤起包含「资产中心、任务队列、创建面板」的工作台，顶栏**实时显示当前账号的 Studio 剩余积分**。 - **60 秒防手滑确认卡片**：Agent 准备发起生成或编辑时，默认先弹出可交互的参数确认卡片（展示输入视图快照、网格/贴图配置与本地秒算的预估积分）。**卡片真正渲染可见后才开始 60s 倒计时，点击编辑立刻暂停**，彻底杜绝 AI 误操作偷跑你的会员积分。 ![60 秒防手滑参数确认卡片]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin/main/docs/images/configuration-dark.png) ### 🚀 1 分钟安装上手 **直接复制下面这段话发给你的 Codex ，让 AI 自己帮你装好**： ```text 请帮我安装 Tripo Studio for Codex 插件。 项目地址： https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin 请先检查本机是否有 Node.js ≥ 22 、npm / npx 和支持插件的 Codex CLI ，缺少时帮我安装或配置。 然后执行以下命令： codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin.git --ref main codex plugin add tripo-studio-plugin@tripo-studio-plugins 安装成功后提醒我开启新聊天，再发送“检查 Tripo Studio 登录状态，需要的话帮我登录”，然后发送“打开 Tripo 工作台”。 ``` --- ### 🔗 开源地址 - **GitHub （ MIT 开源，求个 Star ⭐）**： https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin - **NPM**： https://www.npmjs.com/package/tripo-studio-plugin 欢迎手里有 Tripo 会员、平时做独立游戏、Web3D 、3D 打印或者重度使用 Codex 的朋友试试看，有任何问题或建议欢迎直接在帖子里交流或提 Issue ！

projects.title: Show HN: Korosta – Remember and highlight job postings you've seen
projects.author: gocova
projects.summary: # What is and whats not Korosta is a privacy-first user-customizable tool to highlight job postings based on how frequent are those, and your ratings: * how often the job postings appeared to the user -> fade repeatedly seen job postings * learns from your ratings with a simple local model -> highlight relevant ones * 2 versions: free and pro * almost everything is kept local (ratings, recipes, customizations, history), only licensing and payments require a server * no account required to use it (just when doing the purchase) This is not a job tracker, job board, or automated application system. It just annotates what you already have visible in your browser's tab. ## Links chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/korosta/dhpnogbefak... firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/korosta/ Howto create recipes fast (With the help of a LLM): https://covatools.com/korosta/howtos/create-cookbook-with-an... Website (with ultra short videos): https://korosta.app # Why This idea started like 2 years ago, when I was laid off from a tech company (2024's common rounds), and I started the stressful job searching. For job searching, my main platform was, and still is, linkedin: I perfected my url parameters so I can easily have my 10 different tabs. But one questions that commonly had, was "Have I already seen this job post?", and honestly, I wont be saving manually every item in a tool like trello (or the new ones). That question plus my bad memory had me with: "that role is awesome!!! ohhh I already seen it... but 2 months ago" (something like job posting recycling? maybe). The main objective of this tool/extension is to reduce the load / fatigue of remembering what you have already seen (and not in just a single site), and also highlight what could be interesting to you personally (by learning with your ratings) -> less time searching, and thus, giving more time to apply in the relevant ones, or doing something else (like recovering your energy). One thing I also spent time around was in the customization / editor (+ the howto in the page), so almost anybody can extend the tool (recipes/cookbook) <- I get frustrated when I love a tool but I fully depend on the developer # beyond the technical part (more context... you can skip it, and test already) Around 16.5 years ago I wanted to develop and sell apps, like the trend in those days... I did not. One year ago, I was thinking the same with the first version, the tool was working (even though over engineered), but I got discouraged by myself by reading all the terms of services, legal + fiscal topics, all the things that I did not know... plus some sites are very aggressive with their terms of use and tools like this. I got a job, then changed my career path to a contractor, and meanwhile I started looking for a job again, but since the end of 2025 I really understand the new difficulties of the job market + not being sooo young, so I took the previous tool, refurbished it but with a different mindset: customization first with a simple learning algorithm so it can highlight interesting jobs to the user -> the name of the tool "Korosta" means highlight in Finnish (its difficult to find a good name ha). I do think that is even more relevant to release it now because of AI: some platforms are pushing heavily their AI-based search engines, that are not so easy yet to customize -> putting more stress / burden on us. In terms of monetization, I defined it based on: I am not keen of subscriptions, I grew up with shareware (like Doom... you can guess my age now), and when a single payment give you something (I wont distribute this in floppies, though). And it ended like: pay once and keep for the same major version. I learned a lot, and I am still learning, with this development, so I want to hear your comments. Also, If you are looking for a job right now, how does the extension feel to use?

projects.title: Show HN: A Safari extension to accelerate animated WebP images
projects.author: 76SlashDolphin
projects.summary: Hi HN! The other day I had to do some work with a lot of large animated WebP files on my Macbook running Safari and noticed that it handles them very poorly. They load slowly and it seems like they're constantly being decoded, also with really poor performance. Here's a website with similar images to what I was working with: https://colinbendell.github.io/webperf/animated-gif-decode/w... On that website, my M1 Macbook Air decodes the boat and smoke images at fewer than 5FPS, and the brown underwater office one has a constant stutter. The performance on my iPhone 15 Pro is very similar with the additional annoyance that I have to manually "Play" each animation. This was one of those small things that bothered me during my work week so on the weekend I decided to see if I can do something about it. I started by experimenting with the decoder itself and noticed that if you decode a static WebP image it's pretty fast - approximately as fast as other browser engines. It's actually fast enough to fit in 0.16ms. So I thought "what if I just take the WebP animation decode the frames one by one with the internal decoder and just plonk them on a canvas" and after quickly vibe coding the experiment, the images on the test page played at 60FPS flawlessly. So I reported the issue to Apple, and then made an extension that will find animated WebP images in webpages and swap them out for the same trick. Have a look here: https://github.com/IliaMManolov/safari-animated-webp-extensi... It's currently GitHub-only and I've spent about a day on this all-in-all but I hope anyone that has to interact with similar images in the future finds it useful. Let me know if there's interest in this too, I'd happily put it on the App Store if I can somehow have the extension cover the developer fee.

github.description: 大模型三国志：三国志14全武将数值 × Artificial Analysis 模型评测快照 × 加权映射方法论

projects.summary: 把 Artificial Analysis 2026-10-10 的模型评测快照（697 个模型，687 个有分）和《三国志14 威力加强版》1180 名武将的五维放在一起：武力对应智能指数，智力对应性价比，按加权百分位距离为模型匹配武将。主公位由厂家坐，比如曹操 = OpenAI、孙权 = Meta。演义版编排了 102 席，做成一个美漫风的静态单页，不需要 API Key。 亮点 公式公开：折算武力 = round(模型 II ÷ 榜首 II × 100)，匹配分数 = 0.7 × 武力百分位差 + 0.3 × 智力百分位差 两套结果：脚本自动匹配的"天命版"，和人工编排、受公式约束的"演义版"；站点上标出 8 组数值锚点，例如 Claude Opus 5.5 ↔ 吕布（100 : 100） 只用 Python 3 标准库，脚本把 CSV 生成单个静态 HTML，发布在 GitHub Pages，支持手机宽度 武将数值和立绘版权归 KOEI TECMO（经 Nobuwiki 整理），评测数据归 Artificial Analysis，详见 NOTICE

projects.author: alapha888

github.name: alapha888/pubaudit
github.description: Batch-convert Microsoft Publisher (.pub) files to PDF and verify every output — Publisher retired Oct 2026

projects.summary: 微软已把 Publisher 移出 Microsoft 365、永久版支持也将于 2026 年 10 月结束，手里有成批 .pub 存档的人需要把它们转成 PDF 留底。PubAudit 在本地批量转换一个文件夹里的 .pub 文件，并逐份核验产出（是否存在、有页数、能提取文本），按 OK / REVIEW / FAILED 三档生成报告，专防「转换器报成功却没产出」这类静默失败。全程本地运行，文件不上传。 亮点 1. 不看退出码、只看产出：实测中一个截断的 .pub 让转换器以退出码 0 结束却没有生成任何 PDF，PubAudit 靠检查产出是否存在将其判为 FAILED；一个改名的纯文本假 .pub 也被 OLE2 文件头检查拦下判 FAILED。 2. 三档分流代替一句「转换完成」：OK 可直接归档，REVIEW 表示 PDF 已生成但文本很少、删原件前需人工看一眼，FAILED 明确列出需要单独处理的文件。 3. 依赖简单：Python 标准库脚本，转换由本地 LibreOffice 完成，验证用 poppler 的 pdfinfo/pdftotext；递归扫描并保留原目录结构，报告同时输出 CSV 与 HTML。

projects.summary: 我是维护者，自荐 LeanFPS：MIT 开源的 Windows 10/11 游戏工具，Rust + egui 编写，约 6.5 MB 原生单文件，无需 .NET、WebView 或账号。它识别游戏并按配置调整 Windows 设置，通过 ETW 记录 FPS 与 1% low，保存原值供逐项撤销。免费核心含检测、测量和 5 项调整，可选 Pro 当前 19 美元一次性付费。初学者可参考原生桌面界面和 Windows 事件追踪实现。 亮点 可以作为 open-source Radiant Optimizer alternative：完整 MIT 源码可阅读、修改和自行构建，约 6.5 MB 单文件；免费功能没有到期限制，可选 Pro 采用一次性价格。 更适合用自己的会话数据判断调整是否有效：平均 FPS、1% low 和历史会话都来自 Windows 事件追踪，没有游戏内注入覆盖层。每项调整保存原值并提供 Undo；临时调整退出时恢复，持久设置需要撤销。不关闭 Defender、内存完整性、防火墙或 Windows Update，不承诺固定帧率提升。 官网及下载：

projects.summary: 易设（Protolab）是一款运行在浏览器中的轻量原型设计工具，面向产品经理、设计师、前端开发者及独立开发者，将界面搭建、交互设计、AI 辅助生成和原型导出整合在同一工作区，帮助用户快速把想法转化为可体验、可分享的界面原型。 作品采用组件库、画布与属性面板的三栏布局，支持通过拖拽搭建手机、平板和电脑界面。用户可以编辑文字、图片、尺寸、配色与间距，利用网格、标尺、吸附和多选对齐完成布局，并通过设备外框、系统栏和安全区模拟实际展示效果。 主要功能包括： - **可视化编辑**：提供 23 个内置组件，支持创建和复用 HTML、SVG 及图片组件。 - **交互原型**：支持多页面、弹窗、Toast，以及页面跳转、返回和元素显示隐藏。 - **AI 辅助设计**：接入兼容接口后，可通过自然语言修改画布、生成组件或页面，并结合工程配色与设计规范完成设计。 - **工程与版本管理**：支持多工程切换、草稿自动保存、撤销重做、版本回退，以及 AI 修改与本地编辑的冲突合并。 - **导入与导出**：支持工程 JSON 备份、HTML 导入，以及导出可独立打开和交互的 HTML 原型。 作品使用 HTML、CSS 和原生 JavaScript 模块构建，无框架、无后端、无运行时依赖，可部署到静态网站。工程数据保存在当前浏览器，界面支持中英文切换，适用于需求沟通、方案验证、界面演示和个人项目设计。

projects.summary: 写下方程，它就把方程的运动画出来。一个用 Rust 写的实时生成艺术引擎：洛伦兹吸引子等奇异吸引子、力场和物理驱动成千上万个发光的点和字形，经过 HDR 泛光渲染，直接在屏幕上动起来。 可以直接玩的东西 Windows 下双击就能跑的洛伦兹吸引子演示，不用装 Rust：proof-lorenz.exe，也有 10 个演示加编辑器的合集，以及 Linux 版 一个“数学屏保”：引擎里的十种奇异吸引子轮流播放，每个点都由方程实时驱动，下载 .scr 右键安装即可 在自己的 Rust 程序里用：cargo add proof-engine 怎么做的 每一帧在 CPU 上用 RK4 推进 4 万个洛伦兹状态，每个状态变成一个字形实例，一次实例化绘制调用画完；再画进半精度浮点 HDR 缓冲区，让重叠处的亮度叠加超过 1.0，最后做泛光和 ACES 色调映射。README 里有一张动画示意图把这四步画出来了。 有中文 README：

projects.summary: Filee 是一款免费开源的离线文件格式转换工具，Windows 为正式版，macOS 和 Linux 为预览版。按住 Ctrl（macOS 为 Option）拖动文件，光标处会弹出格式圆环，放到目标格式上，转换后的文件就保存在原文件旁边。支持约 180 种格式，图片、PDF、Word、Excel、PPT、电子书、压缩包、字体、CAD 图纸和韩文 HWP 都不需要安装 Office，视频和音频可选用 FFmpeg。全程在本机处理，文件不会上传。 亮点 拖动手势直接调出格式圆环，只显示适合当前文件的格式，不用打开窗口再找导出菜单。 能自动规划多步转换，比如 HWP → HWPX → DOCX、EPUB → HWPX → PDF → PNG，每一步交给最擅长的引擎。 预设可以设置质量、尺寸、页码范围、保存位置和文件名，支持批量并行转换、合并 PDF、打包成一个 ZIP，还能监视文件夹自动转换。 自带 filee 命令行，可以在脚本里批量转换，结果支持 JSON 输出。 对想学桌面开发的人来说，这是一个完整的 C# + Avalonia 跨平台应用。每种转换引擎都实现同一个 IConverter 接口，docs 里有架构说明和“添加一个转换器”的教程，界面也有无头渲染测试，可以直接对照着读代码。 MIT 协议，没有账号、广告和数量限制。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Droidline，用几行代码让安卓手机自己动起来，不用 ADB 和 root
projects.author: KnifeLemon

github.name: KnifeLemon/Droidline
github.description: Android automation from code. Test your apps on real phones, script the tasks you repeat, run a shelf of phones, or let an AI agent use one, from Python, Node.js, the CLI, HTTP or Appium clients. No ADB, no USB cable, no root.

projects.summary: 手机装一个应用，扫码和电脑配对一次，之后电脑上的 Python、Node.js、C# 代码或命令行就能通过 Wi-Fi 操作手机：按文字找到按钮点下去、输入文字、截图、读取通知。不用开 USB 调试，不用 root，免费开源。 能做什么 在真机上测试自己的应用，包括跨应用的流程，比如登录时去短信里拿验证码（Android 14 及以下，15 起系统会隐藏通知里的验证码） 读取通知并处理，比如银行到账通知一来，就自动把订单标记为已收款 同一个脚本同时跑在多部手机上。手机可以和电脑在同一个 Wi-Fi，也可以用移动数据通过隧道或自建中继连回来，全程端到端加密 交给 AI：自带 MCP 服务器，Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 这类 AI 可以看手机屏幕并操作 命令行也能用，比如 droidline touch text "设置" 怎么做的 电脑端是 Go 写的服务器，手机端是 Kotlin 写的无障碍服务。找元素这一步直接在手机上完成，不像 adb + uiautomator 那样每次都把整个界面导出成 XML 文件再读回电脑。在 Galaxy S23 Ultra 上按文字找一个元素，10 次中位数是 16 ms，Appium UiAutomator2 是 100 ms，adb + uiautomator 是 2,368 ms。 所有命令写在一份规格文件里，Python、Node.js、C# SDK、命令行和 MCP 工具都从它生成，所以 touch 在哪里都叫 touch。 踩过的一个坑：一开始内置了开关 Wi-Fi、飞行模式的命令，做法是打开系统设置去点按钮。结果每家厂商、每个 Android 版本、每种语言的按钮文字都不一样，光是三星的韩文系统就把飞行模式叫“搭乘飞机模式”，小屏手机上要点的那一项还在屏幕外面。最后把这些命令删了，改成文档里的示例，按自己手机上的文字改一下就能用。关 Wi-Fi 这种会断开连接的步骤，可以放进 batch 交给手机离线执行，重新连上后再把结果交回来。 下载 应用和电脑端： （Android 9 及以上；电脑支持 Windows、macOS、Linux） SDK：pip install droidline、npm install droidline、dotnet add package Droidline 文档：

projects.title: 【自荐】Auten：让 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor 直接操作你的电脑和 Android 手机（MCP 服务器）
projects.author: mbicecode-ctrl

github.name: auten-ai/auten-mcp
github.description: Computer-use MCP server: give Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client hands on a real screen: your computer (Mac/Windows/Linux) and your Android phone (beta). Clicks, types and reads the screen, even in apps with no API.

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一下我们做的 Auten，一个 computer-use MCP 服务器。 AI 编程助手很会写代码，但遇到没有 API 的软件就没办法了：桌面客户端、老的后台系统、只能在手机 App 里完成的操作。Auten 给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或任何 MCP 客户端一双"手"：在真实屏幕上点击、输入、读取内容。支持你的电脑（macOS / Windows / Linux X11），以及通过 USB 连接的 Android 手机（beta）。 几个设计点： 优先读取系统的无障碍树（accessibility tree）：智能体拿到的是带编号的真实按钮和输入框（listelements 然后 clickat(3)），而不是猜坐标。没有无障碍信息的 App 再用 OCR 和截图。 任务做成一次后可以保存为技能（skill）。下次重放不调用模型、不消耗 token，几秒完成；界面变了会自己修复。 密码保存在本机（macOS / Windows 钥匙串，Linux 本地私有保险库）。filllogin 在本机直接填入，模型看不到明文。 安装（第一步装本地运行程序，Linux 上会用一次 sudo 安装依赖）： bash curl -fsSL | bash claude mcp add -s user auten -- npx -y @autenai/mcp AI 用你自己的（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或自己的 API key），Auten 只负责"手"。免费版每月 30 分钟运行时间，不用绑卡；付费版目前是早期价格。界面和文档暂时只有英文。说明一下：本地运行程序不开源，GitHub 仓库里是 MIT 协议的 npm 启动器、各客户端配置和文档。

projects.title: Show HN: Open Components – UI Components standard for people, devs and AI agents
projects.author: alexgrozav
projects.summary: Hello awesome people, I've been thinking a lot lately about how I can make my knowledge and craft more valuable in the times we live in. I've been building UI libraries for the past 10 years, and I've been on a quest to perfect the components that I build. I want to share my knowledge with you. Like most of you, probably, I've been using a lot of AI in my craft, and I feel most of the time the code is just good enough, but never at the level of quality that I strive for or that I would reach if I wrote it by hand. That needs to change, and I want it to change for everyone else, too. That's how the Open Components initiative was born. Each component gets a single page that walks through four directions: User Interface, User Experience, Developer Experience, and Agentic Experience, and ends with a checklist. Every rule in it has an ID like `button/keep-focus`, a level and a way to check it, so you or your agents can cite it in a code review. Every page is also published as markdown, and provides the contract as a YAML file, containing every rule in about an eighth of the page’s length. It’s still early. Right now there are only the Button and Input components and a page on how to name your design tokens. Each component comes with a reference implementation that meets every rule, along with its tests. Reference implementation is in Vue for now, since that’s my daily driver, but the documentation comes with code examples from multiple UI frameworks. More components will follow, with the same structure. It isn’t a component library, so there’s nothing to install. It’s a set of rules you can hold your own components to, whichever library or framework you use. I’d love your feedback and contribution. Tell me what you think of the rules, what I’ve missed, and which component you’d like to see next. Thanks for reading! Site: https://opencomponents.dev Button: https://opencomponents.dev/docs/components/button GitHub: https://github.com/uxfront-com/open-components

projects.author: enopkf
projects.summary: 想练德语等外语的口语，发现市面上的一些收费 App 无非就是集成了现成的大模型和语音 API ，多包装了一些预设场景而已。其实对于语言初学者来说，解决开口问题和细致的纠音，一个小工具就足够了。所以我自己用 Muse 搞出了这个小工具，今天开源出来。 项目叫 **芯语伴 SprechMate**，核心功能是：**和 AI 聊天 → 一键生成母语原声 → 录音跟读 → 拿到发音评分。** **只需填入大模型 API （比如我自己用的 Gemini 每月送的 10 美元 Vertex API ）和微软 Azure 免费的 Speech Key （ F0 免费层每月 5 小时评估时长，完全够用）即可使用。纯静态 PWA ，所有 Key 、聊天记录和录音缓存全部在本地（ IndexedDB ），数据不出本机。** --- ### **主要功能：** * **多语言 AI 聊天**：支持德 / 英 / 日 / 法等 23 种语言，OpenAI 兼容接口，SSE 流式输出，提示词模板按语言自动切换 * **一键原声与跟读**：点击任意对话直接生成 Azure 神经网络语音，支持 0.5x-1.5x 变速；同一句话本地缓存，绝不重复消耗 API * **音素级发音评分**：提供总分 / 准确度 / 流利度 / 完整度，细化到单词和音素，读错、漏读、多读按颜色直观标注 * **自定义场景模板**：内置系统提示词保存功能（例如设定“海关官员”等情景），随时切换，支持译文块折叠与隐藏 * **打卡与用量统计**：自动统计自然月内的 API 消耗并估算花费；内置 40 实拍背景 + 400 句谚语库生成今日打卡图 * **多设备同步**：通过二维码互扫即可同步今日练习计数，完全不需要后端服务器 --- ### **技术栈：** 纯前端静态页面，单文件 `index.html`（内联 CSS/JS ）+ PWA 。无构建、无依赖、无外部 SDK ，聊天与发音评估全靠浏览器原生 `fetch` 直连 API 。 --- ### **极简部署（以 Cloudflare Pages 为例，免命令行）：** 1. 登录 Cloudflare Dashboard -> **Workers & Pages** -> **创建应用程序** -> 切换到 **Pages** -> **上传资产** 2. 把整个项目目录（包含 `index.html`、`manifest.json`、图标等）直接拖进上传框 3. 点击 **Deploy**，一键搞定！ > 💡 **PWA 体验建议**：推荐在手机浏览器打开部署后的链接，选择「添加到主屏幕」即可获得完整的 App 级体验（离线可用）。安卓端支持极好，甚至支持在别的 App 选中句子通过“分享”发给本工具直接朗读； iOS 受限于系统机制，建议直接用网页版。 --- **在线体验 Demo**： https://sprechmate.308611.xyz/ **GitHub**： https://github.com/2-3-5-7/SprechMate 具体的补充练习方法和思路，可以看看仓库里的 `README-CN.md` 欢迎试用，有问题直接开 Issue ，也欢迎 PR 开发自己喜欢的功能！

projects.author: zw-onemaker-ai

github.name: zw-onemaker-ai/agent_gate
github.description: AI Agent 管线可靠性操作系统 —「Agent 管编，闸门管信」：一句话需求 → 自动 Agent 团队 → 每步验证拦截 → 定向回环自愈

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个开源项目： 它是一个多 Agent 管线的「可靠性层」。起因是我用多个 AI Agent 协作跑 12 步开发管线，被「静默失败」坑了很多次：Agent 说「测试全过」，实际没跑；说「文件写好了」，磁盘上是空的。我统计了一下，不加验证的管线成功率只有六成左右，而且大部分失败没有任何报错。 AgentGate 的思路是把「不信任」做成机制：每个 Agent 的产出必须过三道闸门才算数——① 产出文件真实存在且非空；② 所有验证命令必须贴出 EXITCODE（Agent 可以编话，编不了退出码）；③ 面向用户的产出过脱敏检查。任何一道不过，按错误类型定向回环给对应 Agent 修，连续失败升级人工闸门。 几个我觉得有意思的点：执行调度是纯规则引擎，一行大模型都不调——PASS/FAIL 可追查、可复现；管线跑到一半崩了能断点恢复；127 个测试全过。仓库里有 3 个 Demo，clone 下来不用模型、不用 key，一条命令就能看到闸门怎么拦截假产出。 MIT 协议，欢迎提 issue 和拍砖。

projects.title: Show HN: Higherlevel – Define and review what AI agents build
projects.author: cyan_indigo
projects.summary: Hi HN! I'm Ryan, I'm building Higherlevel ( https://higherlevel.to ) so product teams have one place to define and review software changes. Over the last couple of years, I've been increasingly delegating software implementation to AI coding agents. However, because it became easier and faster to ship complexity, I realised that it still takes me quite some time to even understand what the software is doing, why it is doing that, or review the changes. I also don't do traditional code reviews anymore, it's mostly automated but I still want to review the final outcome of the changes (rather than its implementation). I regularly work on complex B2B applications where a single feature can involve dozen of business rules, edge cases and interactions with existing functionality. I found myself spending more and more time discovering and explaining requirements to agents, reviewing their output, asking for evdience and trying to establish whether we actually agreed on what correct behaviour looked like. So I built Higherlevel. The idea is to bring product specifications and proof of work into a single collaborative workspace. You can: - describe the current behaviour, known limitations and expected changes - define business rules, acceptance scenarios using Given/When/Then - demand evidence in the form of a screenshot, a video, etc - comment directly on the spec, on a specific area of the image or a timestamp of the video - discuss changes, track revisions and approve results with your team I've written extensively about why I believe in specification driven development (and what it means to me) here https://higherlevel.to/blog/introducing-higherlevel Higherlevel is currently in beta and built with Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, and PostgreSQL.
